### MVB Financial Corp. to Attend the Sidoti Small-Cap Virtual Conference


September 15, 2026


FAIRMONT, W.Va.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


MVB Financial Corp. (NASDAQ: MVBF) (“MVB Financial,” “MVB” or the “Company”), the holding company for MVB Bank, Inc. (“MVB Bank”), today announced that it will participate in the Sidoti Small-Cap Virtual Conference, taking place September 23-24, 2026.


Larry F. Mazza, Chief Executive Officer and President, and Michael Sumbs, Chief Financial Officer will present and participate in one-on-one investor meetings throughout the conference. The presentation will begin at 10:45 a.m. ET on Thursday, September 24. To join the presentation, please register[here](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fsidoti.zoom.us%2Fwebinar%2Fregister%2FWN_tEKxfPAUSIiJttHWXchm4g%23%2Fregistration&esheet=54604864&newsitemid=20260915471951&lan=en-US&anchor=here&index=1&md5=9dc2053516f69b9b41194d1f9cb548e6) .


A webcast of the presentation will also be available on MVB’s investor relations website at[ir.mvbbanking.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.mvbbanking.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54604864&newsitemid=20260915471951&lan=en-US&anchor=ir.mvbbanking.com&index=2&md5=18186e072a33444a2c8ccd17c4a7acde) (under Events and Presentations section).


**About MVB Financial Corp.**


MVB Financial Corp. (Nasdaq: MVBF) is an innovative bank powering Fintech solutions in payments, card issuance and online gaming programs for leading Fintech companies nationwide, while providing traditional retail and commercial banking services within established markets. MVB’s comprehensive platform includes money movement solutions across all modalities and embedded finance capabilities. MVB combines proven Fintech builder/incubator capabilities, innovative culture, regulatory expertise, core banking and AI-driven operational efficiency to enable Fintech partners to navigate complex regulatory requirements while accelerating time-to-market. For more information about MVB, please visit[ir.mvbbanking.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.mvbbanking.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54604864&newsitemid=20260915471951&lan=en-US&anchor=ir.mvbbanking.com&index=3&md5=a4741d41c87cd17b68167ca220a0c446) .
